final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.throws, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) AS manager_count FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), shares AS (SELECT throws, manager_count, 1.0 * manager_count / SUM(manager_count) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), stats AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.manager_count) AS total_count, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - stats.avg_share) AS average_excess FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN stats WHERE s.share > stats.avg_share
